notes.title: Available on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Survive 10 Minutes Please - Now Available on Steam Deck! 


We're thrilled to announce that our action-packed 2D roguelike zombie game, Survive 10 Minutes Please, is now available on Steam Deck – and it's completely free to play!

In this heart-pounding adventure, you're plunged into a relentless zombie horde. Your mission? Survive for 10 adrenaline-filled minutes. Sounds simple? Think again!

Game Features:
Intense Action: Battle your way through waves of ferocious zombies.
Roguelike Elements: Every playthrough offers a new challenge.
Character Upgrades: Enhance your abilities to become a formidable survivor.
Ability Selection: Tailor your gameplay with a variety of unique abilities.
Challenging Gameplay: Designed to test your zombie survival skills to the limit.
Whether you're a seasoned zombie slayer or new to the apocalypse, Survive 10 Minutes Please offers a gripping and immersive experience. With its roguelike elements, every game is a fresh battle for survival.

So, are you ready to take on the challenge? Grab your Steam Deck, download the game for free, and see if you can outlast the undead horde.

Survive, upgrade, and conquer! Will you make it through the 10 minutes?

notes.title: Survive 10 Minutes Please" is Now Free to Play!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

I am thrilled to announce that "Survive 10 Minutes Please" is now available as a free-to-play game! This decision was made to allow more players to experience the challenges and excitement of surviving the relentless zombie hordes.

To Current Owners: First and foremost, I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to each of you who have supported the game by purchasing it. Your early support and feedback have been invaluable in shaping this game. While I am unable to offer any in-game rewards at this time, please know that your support has not gone unnoticed. I am immensely grateful for the community that has built up around the game and I hope you continue to enjoy the game, perhaps even introducing it to friends now that it's more accessible!

To New Players: Welcome! You're stepping into a challenging world of survival and strategy. Prepare to face hordes of zombies in an action-packed setting. Remember, every playthrough is a new challenge, and I can't wait to see how you strategize, adapt, and survive.

As we move forward with this new chapter, I look forward to seeing more players join our community. The game may now be free, but the challenge and excitement remain the same. I encourage all players, old and new, to leave feedback, share your thrilling survival stories, and become an active part of the "Survive 10 Minutes Please" community.

Thank you all for your continued support and enthusiasm. Let's survive those 10 minutes, shall we?

Best regards,

Avi Malviya

notes.title: Level Up and ability Choose
notes.notes:
We introduce XP and level up system where the player will gain XP by killing enemies, level up after some XP gain, and choose a new ability at each level up.

Stronger enemy kills give more XP to level up.
The ability to pick up will affect players in certain ways described below:
1- Health regeneration
2-Stamina Regeneration
3- Gun Damage
4- Knife Damage
5- Movement Speed
6- Landmines area damage size
7 - Grenade damage
8 - Extra resources Pick Up

[b]Note[/b]: In some abilities pick up player will see level 1, level 2 upgrade(for ex: Gun damage level 1 upgrade). That upgrades and abilities are independent of each other, If you want to have maximum stats for a particular upgrade for example Knife Damage then choose level 1 knife damage + level 2 knife damage for maximum damage.
